pillars.name: Ingredient Deep-Dive
pillars.description: What a specific active (niacinamide, Vitamin C, peptides, retinoids, ceramides, sunscreen filters...) actually does, at what concentration and pH, and what the evidence supports.

pillars.name: Formulation Science
pillars.description: How the base, pH, stability, penetration, preservation and batch consistency determine whether a product works. Lab, manufacturing and stability-testing detail.

pillars.name: India-Specific Context
pillars.description: Humidity, heat, Indian UV levels, Indian cities, Indian labelling rules, contract manufacturers running formulations designed for other climates.

pillars.name: Industry Transparency
pillars.description: The gap between label claims and formulation reality; CoAs, documentation, supplier-run vs independent testing, how the industry works behind the scenes. Critiques systems, not named brands.

pillars.name: Consumer Education
pillars.description: Practical, mechanism-first guidance a reader can act on: what to check, what to ask a brand, how to use a product properly (e.g. sunscreen quantity, layering actives).

pillars.name: Brand Philosophy
pillars.description: Why Skinstinct makes the choices it does: publishing data, not overclaiming, holding itself to the same standard, choices vs beliefs.

pillars.name: Clean Beauty Claims
pillars.description: Evaluating 'clean', 'natural', 'toxin-free', paraben/fragrance fears: what the movement gets right and where the evidence doesn't support it.

pillars.name: Founder Story
pillars.description: Meera's professional history (pharma formulation, the stability review that led to founding Skinstinct), professional mistakes and decisions. Professional, never private.

offTopicExamples: makeup trends, product hauls, generic skincare routines, influencer or celebrity recommendations, 'glass skin' / 'glow' trends, lifestyle, fashion
